questions.question: How many laws of motion did Isaac Newton formulate?
questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

The correct answer is i.e __**3 **__

Isaac Newton formulated __**3**__ laws of motion in 1687.

 
• The **first law** states that a body will continue to remain in rest or moving in a straight line at a constant speed unless an external force acts upon it.
 
• The **second law **states that the time rate of change of a body's momentum is equal in both direction and magnitude of the force imposed on it.
 
• The** third law** states that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.

questions.question: Which gallantry award was conferred on Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman in August 2019?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e __**Vir Chakra **__

__
 
• **Vir Chakra**__ was conferred on Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman in August 2019.

• The Gallantry awards are announced twice in a year i.e on Republic day and on Independence day.
 
• The order of Precedence of these awards is 
 
 
• Param Vir Chakra
 
• Ashoka Chakra
 
• Mahavir Chakra
 
• Kirti Chakra
 
• Vir Chakra
 
• Shaurya Chakra
 
• Param Vir Chakra:
 
 

**The Param Vir Chakra**

 
• This is awarded for most conspicuous bravery or some daring or pre-eminent act of valour or self-sacrifice, in the presence of the enemy, whether on land, at sea, or in the air.
 
• Param Vir Chakra means "Wheel of the Ultimate Brave".

**Ashok Chakra: **

 
• The Ashok Chakra is India's highest peacetime military decoration awarded for valour, courageous action or self-sacrifice away from the battlefield.
 
• It is the peacetime equivalent of the Param Vir Chakra.

 

**Kirti Chakra:**

 
• The Kirti Chakra is an Indian military decoration awarded for valour, courageous action or self-sacrifice away from the field of battle.
 
• It may be awarded to civilians as well as military personnel, including posthumous awards. It is the peacetime equivalent of the Maha Vir Chakra

 

**Vir Chakra:**

 
• Vir Chakra is an Indian gallantry award presented for acts of gallantry in the presence of the enemy on the battlefield.

questions.question: The natural process that warms the Earth's surface is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e __**Greenhouse effect **__

__Concept:__

__
 
• Greenhouse gases such as methane and carbon dioxide in the atmosphere prevent the rays of the Sun reflected from the Earth’s surface to escape the atmosphere thus trapping the radiations.
 
• The trapped radiations warm the Earth’s atmosphere, causing increases in the global temperature. This is called the greenhouse effect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd5c44b5cf473234011f68ec41886c08c55ca3faf9b62e29e211de08b831c1dd.png] 

 
• And because of the increase in temperature icy bodies start melting and increases the sea level.

Explanation:__

__
 
• The natural process that warms the Earth's surface is the **Greenhouse effect**__.
 
• When the energy from the sun reaches the atmosphere of the earth, some of it gets reflected back, while the rest is re-radiated and absorbed by the greenhouse gases.
 
• Greenhouse gases include carbon dioxide, water vapours, ozone, nitrous oxide, methane, and chlorofluorocarbons.
 
• The energy that gets absorbed leads to the warming up of the surface and atmosphere of the earth.

• The Vice President acts as President in the absence of the president due to death, resignation, impeachment, or other situations.
 
• The Vice President of India is also ex officio Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• ​The Vice-President is the second-highest constitutional office in India. ​
 
 
 
• ​**Eligibility for the Vice President -** 
 
 
• Age - **35 years **
 
• Citizen of India 
 
• He should be eligible for election as a **member of Rajya sabha. **
 
• He should not hold any office of profit.
